scene.note: Each repair has one owner at a time, moves from the bench to the desk, and ends when its last owner lets go.

steps.note: A clock comes in, and a repair is opened for it.

value.label: comes back
values: the one owner of the repair

steps.note: Whoever holds the owner holds the repair; when the owner goes, the repair ends with it.

value.label: goes in
values: the owner of a repair, or an empty one

steps.note: A repair is handed to Ambrose's desk, owner and all.
The desk is now the repair's only owner; whoever handed it over holds nothing.

value.label: comes back
values: how many repairs the desk holds

steps.note: Ambrose sees how many repairs wait for their bill.
Ambrose wants to look at one repair before billing it.

value.label: comes back
values: a way to look at the repair, or none

steps.note: He gets a way to look at it, while the desk keeps owning it.
A finished repair leaves Kasimir's bench for billing.
Its owner moves off the bench, and its place on the bench goes; nothing ends.

value.label: comes back
values: the owner of that repair, or an empty one

steps.note: The repair is ready to be handed to the desk, in exactly one place.
